intro: Raptor Ridge is an elevated, rugged expanse in the eastern Wetlands, sitting northwest of the fortified Dragonmaw Gates. It serves as the primary hunting and nesting grounds for packs of ferocious Razormaw raptors, overseen by a particularly vicious matriarch deep within its caverns.

p: Rising above the sodden marshes of the eastern Wetlands, Raptor Ridge is among the most perilous wilderness areas in the region. Vicious Razormaw raptors prowl its crags and rocky trails in large packs, making travel near the foothills of Khaz Modan hazardous for wanderers. At the heart of the ridge lies a brooding cavern dominated by the Razormaw Matriarch, whose aggressive brood aggressively defends their nests against any encroaching predators or foolish travelers wandering too close to the Dragonmaw Gates.
